title: api-diff-monitor
offersHint: Cloudflare Workers MCP server: api-diff-monitor · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lazy-mac.com/api-diff-monitor/mcp

toolsPreview.name: register_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Register an API endpoint to monitor for schema changes. Provide name, url, and optionally method/headers/description.

toolsPreview.name: list_monitored_endpoints
toolsPreview.description: List all registered API endpoints being monitored.

toolsPreview.name: compare_snapshots
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a registered endpoint and compare against its last snapshot to detect schema changes. Or compare two inline JSON objects directly.

toolsPreview.name: get_diff_history
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the schema diff history for a registered endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: detect_breaking_changes
toolsPreview.description: Check if a registered endpoint has had any breaking changes (removed fields or type changes).

toolsPreview.name: delete_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Remove a monitored endpoint and all its snapshots and diff history.
